description: Romanize Hebrew into Latin letters (`direction: "he-to-latin"`, the default), or write Latin spelling in Hebrew letters (`direction: "latin-to-he"`) for name entry and search. Up to 5,000 characters. Uses the monthly character quota.

direction.description: `he-to-latin` (default) romanizes Hebrew. `latin-to-he` writes Latin spelling in Hebrew letters, for name entry and search.

text.description: Text to transliterate, up to 5,000 characters.

name: transliterate
